cycle_report.summary: Cycle 2 deepened the af_engine/dashboard integration by building out the ExecutionEngine core in workspace/ExecutionEngine/engine.py and expanding the test suite to 30 passing tests across three test files (test_core_engine.py, test_integration.py, test_stress.py). The dashboard_v2.py and dashboard_modules/core.py were updated with WebSocket push via socketio.emit('engine_status', ...) on stage changes, af_engine.register_push_callback() wiring, and the /api/engine/status endpoint reading directly from ExecutionEngine.get_status(). The integration.py test file specifically validated the DashboardBridge including websocket_emit_on_stage_change and abort_propagates_to_dashboard. All 30 tests pass in 4.73s.
achievements: ExecutionEngine.get_status() now powers /api/engine/status with live pipeline metrics (worker_count, queued_tasks, completed_tasks, success_rate)
WebSocket push implemented: socketio.emit('engine_status', data, namespace='/mission') fires on every stage change via register_push_callback()
DashboardBridge test class added to test_integration.py validating: status_payload_format, websocket_emit_on_stage_change, engine_heartbeat_signal, abort_propagates_to_dashboard

Stress tests added covering: rapid_snapshot_writes, high_frequency_stage_transitions, concurrent_lock_contention, memory_footprint_under_load, snapshot_queue_overflow_handling, large_payload_serialization
All 30 tests pass in 4.73s (15 core engine, 9 integration including 4 DashboardBridge, 6 stress)
